ruleDefinitions.name: PowerShell Core DLL Loaded Via Office Application
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects PowerShell core DLL being loaded by an Office Product Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\excel\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\mspub\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\outlook\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\onenote\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\onenoteim\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powerpnt\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\winword\\\.exe$")) AND (ImageLoaded = RGX(".*\\\\System\\\.Management\\\.Automation\\\.Dll.*") OR ImageLoaded = RGX(".*\\\\System\\\.Management\\\.Automation\\\.ni\\\.Dll.*")))
